items.title: Danaher (DHR) Is A Key Supplier In Fast Growing Bioprocessing Markets
items.summary: Danaher (NYSE:DHR) is highlighted as a major contributor to global adoption of single use bioreactors in bioprocessing markets. The group is cited as a core supplier in capillary electrophoresis systems used across life sciences workflows. Danaher is also emphasized as a key provider of nucleic acid isolation and purification tools for diagnostics and research applications.
